content: Cross-lingual RAG retrieval degrades 30-50% versus same-language retrieval even with dedicated multilingual embedding models (e.g. BAAI/bge-m3), and generation quality drops further when retrieved context mixes languages with the query language. Rule-based (not semantic/ML) chunking is recommended for multilingual corpora because semantic splitters perform inconsistently across languages; typical chunk sizes ~200 tokens with ~100-token overlap, which is often larger than a single short journal entry — meaning naive chunking would merge unrelated entries or fragments.
